headline: GPT-6.2 is here, and opinions are split
summary: OpenAI dropped GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, cheaper and faster; Gemini now handles chores for you, for free.

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are out
items.pitch: OpenAI's new flagship Astra and everyday model Sol are live. They're cheaper and use fewer tokens, but people online disagree on how good they are.
why: Astra's API price is 80% of the last generation's, with an even lower cached price
Sol's price hasn't changed, and Altman says it's very token-efficient
Peter Yang and others like it, while Theo complains that it asks weird questions
Actually, keep it as written: see the next line
actions: In codex, switch to gpt-6.2-sol and try it on a real spreadsheet or report task you already have
If you're on the Pro 200/500 plan, try 6.2 Sol ultrafast
deep_dive: Compare it with the Claude you usually use: in Simon Willison's tests, its 3D animation wasn't as good as Claude Fable 5.2 or Gemini 4 Carbon. Astra's benchmark scores are also a bit below Fable 5.2.
An OpenAI employee said the early review videos were shot last week, and a lot changed in the last three or four days, so what people say online doesn't match the real experience.
Known downside: during long tasks it throws up internal details you can't make sense of and asks you to make the call.
items.signals: HN 1292 points · 809 comments · Altman 7670 likes · Simon Willison, Theo, Swyx and Dan Shipper have all tried it

items.title: Gemini does your chores for free

why: Runs on Gemini 4 Hydrogen, no extra charge
Made for regular people, no coding needed
